description: A Python class for scraping recipe data from juliegoodwin.com.au, including methods to extract title, author, times, yields, image, ingredients, and instructions.

classes.name: JulieGoodwin
classes.description: A scraper class for recipes from juliegoodwin.com.au, inheriting from AbstractScraper.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the host URL for the scraper.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Returns the author name of the recipe.

methods.name: extract_time
methods.description: Extracts time (prep or cook) based on a keyword from HTML elements.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Returns the number of servings or yields.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Returns the image URL of the recipe.
